question: Which of the following is NOT a key element inherent to any theatre?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Sense of taste'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage is about a theatre group called the Blind Opera, which is one of the only theatre group in India as well as Asia, where all the members are blind. 
 
• The passage states that the members of the group may be visually impaired but - '***... ******they can smell, hear and touch – three elements inherent to any theatre.***'
 
• From this line, we can conclude that the senses of hearing, smelling and touching are the three elements inherent to any theatre. 
 
• Thus, if these senses are all inherent, then the 'sense of taste' is NOT a key element inherent to any theatre.
 
• This makes **option 2** the correct answer.
